Linear Law — what would you plot?

Every model below is curved in x and y, but a straight line in the right disguise — and the whole exam skill is choosing that disguise. So this page doesn’t tell you: you pick what to plot against what. A wrong pick stays bent. The right one snaps straight, and the unknown constants fall out of the gradient and the intercept.
